title: HTML-based Educational Worksheets (Vietnam Grade 2)
summary: Comprehensive system for creating printable educational worksheets for Grade 2 in Vietnam. Includes a structural framework (A4 page simulation, multi-page printing), a reusable component library (multi-choice, logic chains, solution grids), Twemoji integration, and an AI-enhanced variation workflow. Features advanced strategies for difficulty scaling through composite problems and automated illustration generation using specific visual prompts.
